analysis: The code calls `nextElement()` on an `Enumeration` object `loggers` obtained from `LogManager.getCurrentLoggers()`. The call is within a while loop that first checks `loggers.hasMoreElements()`. This ensures that `nextElement()` is only called when there is at least one more element, thus the `NoSuchElementException` condition is avoided under normal single-threaded execution. No other exceptions are declared for this method.
remark: The `NoSuchElementException` is avoided because the loop condition `loggers.hasMoreElements()` guarantees that at least one element exists before each call to `nextElement()`. Therefore, no exceptions from this method are unhandled in this context.
